name: Gishi Nishinomori Natsuki
source:
Main character gets a ripe step sister after parents' remarriage. Brother desires to learn more about his new sister, so his desire overflows into proactive forms.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母再婚后，主人公得到了一位成熟的继妹。哥哥渴望进一步了解新妹妹，欲望逐渐转化为主动行动。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
